notes.title: Teamspeak 3 plugins update and more!
notes.notes:
This new version #3700 gives updated plugins for the new Teamspeak 3 client and additional changes.
[list]
[*]New plugins for Teamspeak 3 client with API 21
[*]VFW speed of encoding is increased
[*]Corrected pure encoder performance test
[*]Added ability to write separate webcam file if webcam overlay is not visible (but it must not be disabled)
[*]Fixed wrong separate webcam file writing when webcam overlay is turned off
[*]Fixed error capturing audio on some systems with Realtek audio hardware when driver reports bad configuration
[/list]
Here is an additional information about how to setup teamspeak plugins. We know three possible plugins locations where TS3 client can find its plugins. Unfortunately, we don't know which are more important.
[olist]
[*]Old style - [i]plugins[/i] subfolder in main TS3 client folder
[*]New style - [i]%APPDATA%\TS3Client\plugins[/i] folder (by default it is [i]C:\Users\[b]username[/b]\AppData\Roaming\TS3Client\plugins[/i], where [b]username[/b] is your windows login name)
[*]Additional way - [i]config\plugins[/i] subfolder in main TS3 client folder
[/olist]
Copy both plugins into one of these folders (or better into all these folders), then run Teamspeak 3 and check add-ons settings. You can find plugins in [i]tools[/i] subfolder of main PlayClaw folder.

notes.title: New release with the Web Browser overlay!
notes.notes:
Now PlayClaw has a new feature useful for streamers - the [b]Web Browser overlay[/b]. This overlay is included in the [b]Streamer Pack DLC[/b] (former Twitch Chat overlay DLC).

Here is the full change log for build #3625
[list]
[*] Added the Web Browser overlay
[*] Steam version can run without the steam client with some features restrictions (DLC, achievements)
[*] Added High PlayClaw process priority option (in common options)
[*] Fixed some DX9 games crash after ALT-TAB
[*] Fixed crash after attempt to stream with not H.264 video codec selected
[*] Fixed possible bad captured OpenGL frames
[*] Fixed wrong achievements conditions (the Forgetful achievement)
[*] Fixed temp sensor for Intel Xeon(R) CPU E5450 
[*] Fixed frame capture crash on some systems in non standard resolutions
[*] Added "/ignoreamd" command line key for PlayClaw5.exe to skip detection of h264 amd accelerator
[/list]

notes.title: New update 3386 is released!

notes.title: New version with Windows 8 desktop capture support
notes.notes:
Build 3045 changes:
[list]
[*]Windows 8 / 8.1 desktop capture
[*]NFS Shift 2 compatibility fix
[*]Minor interface changes & bug fixes
[/list]

Please note, you need to enable desktop mode in Common settings. Special helper window will be opened in right-top screen corner. Hotkeys do not work in desktop mode. Start and stop video recording by clicking button on helper window.
Do not forget to disable desktop mode to get PlayClaw back in game mode.
